title: ICICLE: In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24469v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization allocates training budget by predicting how partially observed learning curves will continue. LC-PFN first applied prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) to learning-curve extrapolation, and FT-PFN extended this approach to configuration-aware freeze-thaw optimization with a ten-slot hyperparameter encoder. We introduce In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation (ICICLE), an in-context surrogate that accepts a variable number of hyperparameters through a shared set encoder and is trained on a synthetic prior covering typed hyperparameters, heavy-tailed noise, quantization, and divergence. ICICLE has 1.28 million parameters (8.7% of FT-PFN's count) and produces similar mean-regret trajectories to FT-PFN on LCBench, PD1, and TaskSet. translated_title: ICICLE：面向学习曲线外推的上下文内推理
translated_abstract: 冻融贝叶斯优化通过预测部分观测到的学习曲线将如何延续来分配训练预算。LC-PFN 首先将先验数据拟合网络（PFN）应用于学习曲线外推，而 FT-PFN 则将该方法扩展为具备配置感知能力的冻融优化，采用了一个十槽超参数编码器。我们提出了面向学习曲线外推的上下文内推理方法 ICICLE，这是一种上下文内代理模型，通过一个共享集合编码器接受可变数量的超参数，并在涵盖类型化超参数、重尾噪声、量化效应和发散现象的合成先验上进行训练。ICICLE 拥有 128 万参数（仅为 FT-PFN 参数量的 8.7%），并在 LCBench、PD1 和 TaskSet 上产生了与 FT-PFN 相似的平均遗憾轨迹。在包含 33 个超参数的 86 项任务的 Meta-Album 基准上，ICICLE 总体上以及在延长预算设置下均取得了比 Quick-Tune 更低的平均归一化遗憾（原文此处截断）。
tldr: ICICLE 是一种轻量级（仅128万参数，约为FT-PFN的8.7%）的上下文内学习曲线外推代理模型，通过共享集合编码器支持可变数量的超参数，在多个基准上以远少于FT-PFN的参数量取得相当性能，并在Meta-Album基准上超越Quick-Tune。
en_tdlr: ICICLE is a lightweight (1.28M parameters, only 8.7% of FT-PFN's) in-context surrogate for learning-curve extrapolation that accepts a variable number of hyperparameters via a shared set encoder, matching FT-PFN's performance with far fewer parameters and outperforming Quick-Tune on the Meta-Album benchmark.
